title: onboard-molten-14b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Lena Park
description: Onboard Molten-14B v1.0: add metadata, performance profiles for our serving runtime, and integrate with changelog/release-notes automation. Motivation: Molten-14B shows strong cost/latency tradeoffs for moderately sized chat workloads and should be available in the model catalog with validated perf profiles and rollout notes. This PR adds canonical metadata (model id, family, tokenizer, quantization support matrix), CPU/GPU perf profiles (p50/p95 latency, throughput at common batch sizes, memory footprints), unit and integration perf tests, and a small automation script to generate changelog entries from metadata diffs so new onboardings produce consistent release notes. Also includes docs for operators (how to pin versions, recommended quantization for Dedicated pools) and a canary rollout config for the console. CI/bench jobs added to validate latencies during PR checks. No API surface changes to serving clients.

release_notes: Onboard Molten-14B v1.0: model metadata, manifest, and perf profiles.
Perf profiles include p50/p95 latency, throughput at batch sizes [1,4,8] on A100-40G and H100-80G, and memory working set estimates.
Added changelog automation: generates release-note snippets from metadata diffs and tags schema changes.
Docs: operator guidance on quantization (recommended int8 for Dedicated), canary rollout config.
notes_for_ops: Recommend starting Dedicated canary at 1% for 24h, verify latency p95 within 15% of reported profiles, monitor token-level cost in Console. If using int8 quantization, run quality evals against the customer's prompt set before full promotion.
safety_and_eval_summary: Ran evaluation harness against standard regression suite (seeded prompts + 2k prompt set). Observed <1.5% QA delta with int8; full-fp shows parity. No toxic content spikes detected in random sample.
